modelContext.modelDescription: Configure context limits published by the gateway. Channels can override them. Leave unconfigured to use the upstream catalog.
modelContext.defaultFallback: When no default is configured, use the effective maximum. The default cannot exceed the maximum supported context.
modelContext.modelScope: Applies to all public model IDs under this model rule.
modelContext.channelDescription: Override context for channel {{name}}; leave blank to inherit the model configuration.
modelContext.requestInheritance: A channel model may serve multiple model rules. Inherited values come from the model matched by each request.
modelContext.activation: Saved settings are published when the client next fetches the model catalog.
modelContext.invalidValues: Enter positive integers. The default context cannot exceed the maximum supported context.
modelContext.invalidRange: The default context cannot exceed the maximum supported context.
